dataset_citation: Li et al., MARS-LVIG dataset, IJRR 43(8), 2024, doi:10.1177/02783649241227968

candidate_audit.reason: publishes raw multi-constellation GNSS observables, hardware-synchronised IMU, independent onboard RTK position and yaw, and CAD antenna offsets
publishes UAV IMU, dual-RTK and calibration but its inspected sensor archives contain receiver PVT/velocity rather than pseudorange and carrier-phase observations required for a libgnss++ solve

development.licence_status: dataset source page has no explicit data licence; article record is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and does not prove dataset redistribution rights
development.redistribution: not permitted by this profile; users fetch from the named source for local evaluation

official_ros1_source.status: Google Drive quota prevented full acquisition; do not claim byte identity with the MCAP derivative

holdout.container_derivative: DapengFeng/MCAP conversion of the named MARS-LVIG flight; topic types/counts are revalidated by the adapter, but provenance is not equivalent to an original ROS1 byte hash
holdout.licence_status: same unresolved dataset licence as development
holdout.redistribution: not permitted by this profile; holdout remains sealed until thresholds are frozen

frame_contract.rtk_truth_frame: WGS84 latitude/longitude and ellipsoidal height at the DJI RTK antenna phase centre
frame_contract.rtk_truth_empty_frame_id_policy: allowed only because this profile explicitly supplies the DJI OSDK NavSatFix semantic frame
frame_contract.navigation_rule: until the fixed rotation is resolved, compare raw and RTK antenna phase centres without rotating the vector and report 0.6157272448089333 m as a separate worst-case reference-point mismatch bound; never describe the result as body-origin accuracy
frame_contract.mapping_rule: No-Go unless full six-DoF independent mapping truth and the LiDAR-to-body rotation are both available; MARS-LVIG bag RTK truth is four-DoF position plus yaw

navigation_product.provider: International GNSS Service merged broadcast ephemeris via the BKG IGS data centre
navigation_product.role: solver input only; not trajectory truth

time_contract.sensor_time: UTC synchronized from UAV RTK GPRMC/PPS
time_contract.raw_gnss_time: GNSS receiver time carried by gnss_comm messages; conversion must preserve week/TOW and declare leap seconds

segmentation.method: motion labels are computed only from independent RTK truth; landing is the final 30 s population and overlaps other motion labels

thresholds.basis: HKisland_GNSS03 development run; rounded outward from the recorded development metrics without inspecting HKairport_GNSS03 payloads
